name: PortfolioVisualizer Monte Carlo Simulation
description: Free web-based tool that runs Monte Carlo simulations on user-defined portfolios to estimate long-term growth, withdrawal sustainability, and success probabilities under historical bootstrapping or parametric return models.
reputation: Highly popular free resource among retail investors, financial planners, and Bogleheads for retirement and portfolio stress-testing.
notes: Results depend on historical data assumptions and chosen simulation parameters; useful for illustration but not financial advice. No dataset contamination issues as it is not an AI benchmark.
